telemetry_consent.heading: Help improve Veyrnox
telemetry_consent.body: Share anonymous usage data so we can fix bugs and improve the experience. No personal info, no balances, no wallet addresses, no tracking across apps.
telemetry_consent.device_id_note: A random device ID is used — never linked to your wallet, keys, or identity. You can change this anytime in Settings → Privacy.

duress.heading: Emergency PIN / Hidden Wallet
duress.subhead: A second PIN that opens a separate wallet. Use it if someone forces you to unlock your phone.
duress.warn_banner: Your PIN opens your wallet. The Emergency PIN opens a decoy. Get it wrong 10 times and this phone wipes.
duress.how_body: Set an Emergency PIN different from your real one. Face ID can open the decoy if you want.
duress.timing_note: Veyrnox spends the same effort on every unlock — whether you enter your real PIN or your Emergency PIN — so the one you used isn't given away by how long unlock takes. It's a safeguard for when someone in the room forces you to unlock, not against a remote attacker watching your connection.
duress.fund_title: Fund the Emergency wallet to make it believable
duress.fund_body: An empty wallet looks suspicious. Send a small amount you're willing to hand over. The real balance comes straight from the blockchain — it can't be faked in the app.
fund_notes: A fresh wallet has no history, which makes it less convincing.
Good to know: someone who examines the device may still find the second wallet.
duress.remove_body: Clears the Emergency PIN and its wallet.
duress.setup_err_length: Emergency PIN must be exactly 8 digits
duress.bio_optin_body: {{label}} always opens the decoy. Your real wallet still needs your typed PIN. Anyone forcing you to use {{label}} only ever sees the decoy.
duress.saved_ok: Emergency PIN saved. Emergency wallet created.
duress.bio_optin_failed: {{label}} could not be set up for this wallet. Sign in with your PIN — the Emergency PIN still works. You can try {{label}} again in Security settings.
duress.bio_turned_off: {{label}} sign-in has been turned off. Sign in with your PIN. You can turn {{label}} back on in Security settings whenever you want.
duress.fund_target_lead: Send a small amount of {{symbol}} on {{network}} to make it look lived-in:
duress.balance_unavailable_title: Could not read balance from chain
duress.faucet_hint: Use a public faucet to get free test {{symbol}}, then send some here.
duress.phrase_note: Recovery phrase for the Emergency wallet. Only save this if you want to reach it from another app.
duress.demo_body: Exercises the real unlock flow. Step 1 creates a throwaway real wallet (password {{real}}) and a hidden wallet (Emergency PIN {{duress}}) seeded with a small {{symbol}} balance. Then unlock with either to compare.
duress.demo_step1: 1. Set up real + funded hidden wallet
duress.demo_wrong_pin_hint: (wrong PINs show an error; the Emergency PIN opens its wallet silently)
duress.demo_locked: Locked. Unlock above to see which wallet opens.
duress.demo_only_decoy: In this session you only see the Emergency wallet.
duress.demo_oracle_hidden: ✓ hidden in this hidden wallet session
duress.demo_reset: Reset demo (delete all wallet data + hidden wallet)
duress.non_demo_hint: Lock your wallet and enter the Emergency PIN to try it. Never share it. Forgot it? Remove it here while unlocked with your real PIN.
